title: Prevent catastrophic backtracking in logs grammar key token regex
answers: Why does the logs panel freeze on long unformatted log lines?
How to fix catastrophic backtracking in log token syntax highlighting?
How should log-token-key regex be defined in logsGrammar?
body:
Symptom: Logs panel UI freezes or lags significantly when rendering log lines without key-value pairs during Prism syntax highlighting.
Root cause: public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts:logsGrammar used (\b|\B) in 'log-token-key', which matches at every character position and triggers quadratic backtracking with (?=\s*=) on long tokens lacking an equals sign.
Fix pattern: Remove (\b|\B) alternation and anchor key token regexes strictly to word boundaries (\b).
Constraints: Applies to log token key regexes where keys begin at word boundaries (e.g., key=val); does not apply if valid keys can start with non-word boundary characters.
applies: Prism grammar token definitions for log highlighting in the logs panel.
